name: public_cashcarry_station_v1_20260716
purpose: Collect a bounded seven-day public-only cash-carry evidence clock with durable per-symbol replay, conservative v2 economics gates, and funding-timestamp-aware scheduling.

adapter.future_portability: A Bitget adapter must implement the explicit station protocol under a separately preregistered source/engine contract. Relabelling Bitget data as Bybit data is forbidden.

schedule.funding_awareness: Next cycle is the earlier of normal poll or 30 seconds after the nearest advertised nextFundingTime. This stays inside the frozen v2 120-second public valuation-proxy window.

bounds.restart: Same run root requires explicit resume and deterministic replay. Terminal roots cannot be reopened.

economics_contract.gate: Frozen v2 minimum(projected, required completed funding rates) must cover walked round-trip spread/slippage, four configured fees, 10 bps basis stress, and 5 bps residual edge.
economics_contract.shadow_open: Allowed only after explicit research-shadow opt-in and frozen v2 gate PASS; it remains paper state with no broker call.
economics_contract.promotion: Forbidden until account-specific fee/cost receipt plus at least 10 completed mechanics cycles and 30 completed cycles across at least 3 liquid symbols pass manual review.

known_limitations: Public REST legs are non-atomic and stale/skew refusal still applies.
The frozen fee schedule is deliberately conservative but is not a receipt for the owner's actual account tier.
No balance, margin, liquidation, transfer, borrow, outage, reconciliation, or two-leg partial-fill recovery model exists.
A public shadow pass is mechanics evidence, not proof of live executable profit.
The current normalized snapshot type is Bybit-specific; Bitget needs a separately frozen adapter and engine parity review.
